title: 第12章 异世界化身交流
slug: 次元论坛全本免费-次元论坛最新章节列表
content_zh:
【丧心病狂，你对妹子做了什么？——攻略之神】
【刀都架脖子上了，是差点装“哔”失败吗？——万事屋老板】
【咦？上面接你的那些人，衣服和我们的制服很像！考虑以后我们要不要也加个面具。——FFF团万岁】
【那个小黄毛看起来很有主角相，我觉得应该提前干掉。——叫我奈落大人】
关立远也看到了“虚夜宫之主”……好吧，已经查了后台记录，其实就是蓝染的帖子。
似乎是在露琪亚被执行“双殛”的时候，蓝染在一旁设置了某种拍照功能的东西，将他取出崩玉、被夜一和碎蜂逼住，以及最后利用返膜，在众目睽睽之下堂而皇之的前往虚界……这几张特写pose全都拍了下来。
照片上的蓝染，气质如同关立远以前知道的那个蓝染一样冷酷，在返膜中离开时，眼神中带着仿佛在嘲讽其他死神的淡然……
与论坛中出现的这只哪有事儿哪到、流连于各种黄段子贴中抢二楼的大水“哔”完全不同！
不过却并没有多少人吐槽这一点，因为这种情况其实很常见。
就像是人在生活中的性格，与在互盲的网络环境中的性格，可能截然相反一样，基于“反正这些网友也不会进入我的生活中”这种思想的话，人就会表现出另外一面！
更何况“大宇宙论坛”在每个世界，只有一名会员，在论坛中的表现，完全不会影响自己的形象，因此性格反差是普遍存在的……
不过关立远却因此而想到了另一点！
【企鹅，我们给论坛加一个直播功能怎么样？】
【技术上可行，不过需要额外消耗论坛币作为能量驱动……有必要吗？】
【不不不，直播是为了赚论坛币！其他用户可以对直播的楼主进行打赏，打赏多了可以增加会员经验、超级多的可以在论坛上公示……】
【你想自己直播赚论坛币？】
【当然不是，我作为一名“高贵的管理员”怎么能去直播？所有打赏的论坛币，我们作为平台全部分一半！】
【听起来不错……恩，为了更好的“用心创造快乐”，我去写个计划书，晚上我们再商量具体流程，你先听听导师在说什么吧。】
关立远相信，多了这个功能之后，论坛中富裕的论坛币就更多了，论坛币的本质是宇宙本源能量，作为唯一的管理员，关立远虽然可以使用论坛结余的能量，但是却不能无中生有的创造能量……
“一共33人，都到齐了对吧？我是之后一年里你们的导师，高阶职业者柳青，至于我的职业……主职业是元素系、辅职业是心灵系……不过这和你们关系不大，毕竟之后一年里，你们的任务就是完成从‘入门’到‘低阶’的转化，也就是……成为一名真正的‘职业者’！”一名看起来三十多岁、皮肤略显黝黑女老师，对关立远在内的三十多名学员说道。

开灵仪式已经过去了一周，全城六所基础教育院校，一共一百二十五人觉醒，这也是杜兰城一年诞生职业者的数量。
觉醒一周后，按照规定所有的新职业者，都进入了“杜兰职业学院”，开始了为期一年的进修……
此时关立远也知道了一些常识，比如“辅职业”……
低阶之后，每次进阶都有觉醒新职业的几率，中阶觉醒的概率极低，高阶觉醒的概率一般，超阶几乎必然会觉醒一个新职业！
至于“入门”到“低阶”，并不能算是提升一阶，更像是柳青所说的，是将“职业者”的力量真正收为己用的过程。
标志就是三大入门技能，将转化为“低阶技能”。
而升阶则不同，比如升入“中阶”之后，低阶的技能依旧存在，是额外衍生出新的中阶技能。
并且“入门”到“低阶”是掌握力量的过程，三种“入门技能”，会分别转化为“低阶技能”，而“低阶”升入“中阶”则是一个“瞬间”……
在晋升的时候，自然而然的，三个“中阶技能”会直接全部衍生出来！
柳青这时也继续说道：“当然，如果有元素系、心灵系的学员，有这方面的问题，也可以来请教我，我希望在一年之中，你们能够全部将自身力量融会贯通！马上就是第一节课了，还有什么问题吗？”
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢次元论坛请大家
content_en:
[Crazy, what did you do to your girl? ——The God of Strategy】
[The knife is on your neck. Did you almost fail to pretend to beep? ——Boss of Wanshiwu】
【Huh? The clothes of the people picking you up above look very similar to our uniforms! Thinking about whether we should also add a mask in the future. ——Long live the FFF group]
[That little yellow fur looks like a protagonist, I think it should be killed in advance. ——Call me Naraku-sama]
Guan Liyuan also saw the "Lord of Xuye Palace"... Well, I have checked the background records, and it is actually Aizen's post.
It seems that when Rukia was being "double-killed", Aizen set up something with a camera function on the side. He took out the Honyu, was forced by Yoruichi and Zaihou, and finally used the return membrane to openly go to the virtual world in full view of everyone... These close-up poses were all taken.
The Aizen in the photo has a temperament as cold as the Aizen Guan Liyuan knew before. When he left the film, he had a look in his eyes that seemed to be mocking the other gods of death...
It's completely different from the "Beep" that appears in the forum and has nothing to do with it, and hangs around in various pornographic posts to grab the second floor!
However, not many people complain about this, because this situation is actually very common.
Just like a person's personality in life may be completely opposite to his personality in a mutually blind Internet environment. Based on the thought "These netizens will not enter my life anyway", people will show another side!
What's more, the "Great Universe Forum" has only one member in each world, and his performance in the forum will not affect his image at all, so personality contrasts are common...
However, Guan Liyuan thought of another point!
[Penguin, how about we add a live broadcast function to the forum? 】
[Technically feasible, but it requires additional consumption of forum coins as energy drive... Is it necessary? 】
[No, no, no, the live broadcast is to earn forum coins! Other users can reward the host of the live broadcast. If you reward too much, you can increase your membership experience. If you reward too much, you can announce it on the forum...]
[Do you want to earn forum coins by live streaming? 】
[Of course not. As a "noble administrator", how can I go live? We, as the platform, will receive half of all the forum coins that are rewarded! 】
[Sounds good... Well, in order to better "create happiness with heart", I will write a plan. We will discuss the specific process in the evening. You should listen to what the instructor is saying first. 】
Guan Liyuan believes that with the addition of this function, there will be more wealthy forum coins in the forum. The essence of forum coins is the original energy of the universe. As the only administrator, although Guan Liyuan can use the remaining energy of the forum, he cannot create energy out of thin air...
"There are 33 people in total, are they all here, right? I will be your mentor for the next year, high-level professional Liu Qing. As for my profession... my main profession is the elemental system, and my secondary profession is the psychic system... But this has little to do with you. After all, in the next year , your task is to complete the transformation from 'entry level' to 'lower level', that is... to become a true 'professional'!" A female teacher in her thirties with slightly dark skin said to more than 30 students including Guan Liyuan.
A week has passed since the opening ceremony. A total of 125 people have awakened from six basic education colleges in the city. This is also the number of professionals born in Dulan City in a year.
One week after awakening, according to regulations, all new professionals entered the "Dulan Vocational College" and began a one-year training...
At this time, Guan Liyuan also knew some common sense, such as "auxiliary professions"...
After the low level, there is a chance of awakening a new profession every time you advance. The probability of awakening at the intermediate level is extremely low, the probability of awakening at the high level is average, and the probability of awakening at the super level is almost certain to awaken a new profession!As for "entry" to "low level", it cannot be regarded as rising to one level. It is more like what Liu Qing said, it is the process of truly using the power of "professional" for one's own use.
The symbol is the three entry-level skills, which will be converted into "low-level skills".
Upgrading is different. For example, after being promoted to "intermediate level", the low-level skills still exist, and new mid-level skills are derived.
And "getting started" to "low-level" is a process of mastering power. The three "entry-level skills" will be converted into "low-level skills" respectively, and the promotion from "low-level" to "intermediate-level" is an "instant"...
When promoted, naturally, all three "intermediate skills" will be directly derived!
Liu Qing continued at this time: "Of course, if there are students from the elemental system and the spiritual system who have questions in this regard, you can come and ask me for advice. I hope that within a year, you can all integrate your own powers! The first class will be soon. Do you have any questions?"
